decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01A Received 26/01/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The hereby approved change of use of the ground floor of 626 Bath Road shall only be used in conjunction with the restaurant (A3 use) at 624 Bath Road and shall not be used as a separate, self-contained restaurant (A3 use) or other commercial use.

Condition : 4 - The use of the ground floor of 626 Bath Road hereby permitted for a restaurant (A3 use) in conjunction with 624 Bath Road shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the restaurant and the residential flat above, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Change of use of the ground floor of 626 Bath Road to operate as restaurant/takeaway with 624 Bath Road.
